name: LiteTex-GS
definition: A fast and lightweight texturing framework for Gaussian Splatting that decouples geometry from appearance. It uses a global-to-local capacity allocation strategy: it initializes compact low-resolution texture maps for all primitives and progressively allocates higher resolution only to primitives with significant reconstruction errors, while using a contribution- and area-aware pruning strategy to eliminate low-utility Gaussians.
summary: LiteTex-GS is a lightweight 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that decouples geometry from appearance by progressively allocating local RGB texture maps based on reconstruction error and frequency content.
